observations: Photo 0 shows an orange LPG gas cylinder with a protective wire mesh cage around the body and a valve/regulator area at the top.
Photo 0 valve area: a brass-colored valve fitting is visible; no clear brand name or cylinder stamp is readable.
Photo 1 is a close-up of the top/valve area inside the cylinder guard; there are no clearly readable markings for brand/model or cylinder capacity.
The seller text says “12kg foreign cylinder”, but the photos do not show any readable capacity/serial/brand stamp.

claims.evidence: Neither photo shows a readable capacity marking (e.g., “12kg”) or foreign brand stamp; only the seller’s text states 12kg.

risks.risk: Cylinder capacity may not be 12kg (could be 6kg/10kg/other), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity and serial number (usually on the neck/shoulder or stamped on the body) in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic LPG cylinder with unknown capacity (worst-case for value: not confirmed 12kg).

risks.risk: Cylinder may be empty, leaking, or have a faulty valve/regulator connection; photos can’t confirm pressure integrity.
risks.proof: Video/clip of a pressure test or leak test (soap-bubble test at the valve/regulator connection) and confirmation of gas flow when opened.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to be working/verified (worst-case: treat as needing testing before use).

risks.risk: Foreign cylinder authenticity/ownership status may be questionable (could be untraceable or not accepted by local refillers).
risks.proof: Photo of the full cylinder markings/serial and any refill/ownership documentation the seller has.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially difficult to refill/verify (worst-case: discount for possible refill/acceptance issues).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible: dents, corrosion, or damaged valve threads can reduce safety and resale value.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the entire body (top ring, valve threads, base) plus a side view showing dents/corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average condition with possible wear (worst-case: assume it may need inspection).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity and serial number (show the exact “12kg” marking if present).
Photo of the valve threads and the full valve/regulator connection area (no blur).
Video of opening the valve and a soap-bubble leak test at the valve/regulator connection.
Full side photo showing the entire cylinder body and base for dents/corrosion.
response.reason: The item appears to be a caged LPG cylinder, but the key pricing driver—confirmed 12kg foreign capacity and safe working condition—cannot be verified from the photos provided.
